source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 12 (PDF 273-290), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nitrogen and Sulfur) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Nitrogen belongs to which group of the periodic table?
(Nitrogen periodic table ke kis group mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen periodic table ke group 15 mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen belongs to group 15 of the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
2 In industry, nitrogen is typically obtained by:
(Industry mein nitrogen aam taur par kaise hasil ki jati hai?)

options.text: hawa ko liquid banne tak thanda karke
ammonia ko hawa mein jala kar

blocks.explanation: Industry mein hawa ko itna thanda kiya jata hai ke woh liquid ban jaye; ammonium nitrite ko garam karna laboratory ka tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: nitrogen is typically obtained by cooling air until it becomes a liquid

blocks.prompt:
3 In the laboratory, nitrogen gas is prepared by slowly heating a solution of:
(Laboratory mein nitrogen gas kis ke mehlool (solution) ko aahista garam karke banai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Laboratory mein ammonium nitrite ke solution ko aahista garam karne se nitrogen banti hai.

book_ref.quote: nitrogen can be generated by slowly heating a solution of ammonium nitrite

blocks.prompt:
4 In the balanced equation for the decomposition of ammonium nitrite, NH₄NO₂ → N₂ + x H₂O, the value of x is:
(Ammonium nitrite ki decomposition (toot phoot) ki balanced equation NH₄NO₂ → N₂ + x H₂O mein x ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₄NO₂ mein 4 H aur 2 O hain, is liye do H₂O chahiye: NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

blocks.prompt:
5 Liquid nitrogen is commonly used for:
(Liquid nitrogen aam taur par kis kaam aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq liquid nitrogen tezi se thanda karne (rapid cooling) ke liye istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Liquid nitrogen is commonly used for rapid cooling purposes

blocks.prompt:
6 According to the table of physical properties of nitrogen, its boiling point is:
(Nitrogen ki physical properties ke table ke mutabiq us ka boiling point kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1 mein nitrogen ka melting point −210 °C aur boiling point −195.8 °C hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Physical properties of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
7 The electronegativity of nitrogen given in the chapter's table is:
(Chapter ke table mein nitrogen ki electronegativity kitni di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1 mein nitrogen ki electronegativity 3.0 hai (sulfur ki Table 12.4 mein 2.5 hai).

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Physical properties of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
8 The two atoms in an N₂ molecule are held together by:
(N₂ molecule ke do atoms kis bond se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har N atom doosre ke saath teen electrons share karta hai, is tarah triple bond banta hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: forming a triple bond by sharing three electrons with another nitrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
9 The bond enthalpy of the N≡N bond is:
(N≡N bond ki bond enthalpy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: N≡N bond ki bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol⁻¹ hai; ise torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye, is liye N₂ bohat kam reactive hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: This bond has a bond enthalpy of +944 kJmol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
10 The bond in N₂ is nonpolar because:
(N₂ ka bond nonpolar kyun hai?)

options.text: dono atoms aik jaise hain, is liye electronegativity ka farq sifar hai

blocks.explanation: Dono atoms aik jaise hain, electronegativity ka farq sifar hai aur bonded electrons barabar share hote hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Both the atoms are the same having zero electronegativity difference

blocks.prompt:
11 Which of the following is NOT given in the chapter as a reason for the low reactivity of nitrogen?
(In mein se kaun si baat chapter mein nitrogen ki kam reactivity (kam taamul) ki wajah NAHI batayi gayi?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter chhota size, symmetrical electronic cloud aur nonpolar triple bond ko wajah batata hai; nitrogen chhota hai, bara nahi (12.1).

book_ref.quote: known for its low reactivity due to its small size

blocks.prompt:
12 To complete its octet, a nitrogen atom (1s² 2s² 2p³) needs:
(Apna octet poora karne ke liye nitrogen atom (1s² 2s² 2p³) ko kya chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 2s² 2p³ ke 5 valence electrons ke saath nitrogen ko octet ke liye teen electrons aur chahiye (12.1).

book_ref.quote: nitrogen requires three electrons to complete its octet

blocks.prompt:
13 The high concentration of nitrogen in air is useful because it:
(Hawa mein nitrogen ki zyada miqdaar kyun mufeed hai?)

options.text: jalne ke liye oxygen deti hai
oxygen ko dilute karti hai, is liye har chingari se bari aag nahi lagti

blocks.explanation: Nitrogen hawa mein oxygen ko patla (dilute) karti hai, is liye har chingari se bari aag nahi lagti (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The high concentration of nitrogen in the air serves to dilute oxygen

blocks.prompt:
14 On ships carrying hydrocarbons or edible oils, blankets of nitrogen are used to protect the cargo from:
(Hydrocarbons ya khaane ke tail le jaane wale jahazon par nitrogen ke blankets cargo ko kis cheez se bachate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ya kisi inert gas ke blankets cargo ko oxygen aur nami (moisture) se bachate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: it is crucial to utilize blankets of Nitrogen or any other inert gas on ships

blocks.prompt:
15 Ammonia is an important industrial compound of nitrogen mainly used as:
(Ammonia nitrogen ka aham industrial compound hai jo zyada tar kis kaam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia zyada tar fertilizer (khaad) ke taur par istemal hoti hai (12.2).

book_ref.quote: which is mainly used as a fertilizer

blocks.prompt:
16 Ammonia is prepared industrially by the:
(Ammonia industry mein kis process se banai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia industry mein Haber-Bosch process se banti hai, N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ (12.2).

book_ref.quote: It is prepared industrially by Haber-Bosch process

blocks.prompt:
17 In the Haber-Bosch reaction N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, how many moles of NH₃ can form from 4 mol of N₂ with enough H₂?
(Haber-Bosch reaction N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ mein 4 mol N₂ (kaafi H₂ ke saath) se kitne mol NH₃ ban sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 mol N₂ se 2 mol NH₃ banti hai, to 4 mol N₂ se 4 × 2 = 8 mol NH₃ (12.2).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia (NH₃) is an important industrial compound of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
18 Ammonia behaves as a Lowry-Brønsted base because it:
(Ammonia Lowry-Brønsted base kyun hai?)

options.text: H⁺ se electron pair leti hai
apne molecule se OH⁻ deti hai

blocks.explanation: Ammonia acid se proton (H⁺) leti hai aur ammonium banati hai, is liye Lowry-Brønsted base hai (12.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia behaves as a Lowry-Brønsted base by accepting a proton

blocks.prompt:
19 When ammonia dissolves in water, the ions present in the equilibrium are:
(Ammonia jab paani mein hal hoti hai to equilibrium mein kaun se ions hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq); is solution ko ammonium hydroxide kehte hain (12.2.1).

book_ref.quote: It dissolves in water to form ammonium hydroxide (NH₄OH)

blocks.prompt:
20 Ammonia solution is a weak base because:
(Ammonia ka solution kamzor base kyun hai?)

options.text: is ka Kb kam hai aur equilibrium bohat baayen taraf hai
yeh paani mein hal nahi hoti
yeh paani mein H₃O⁺ banati hai

blocks.explanation: Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ kam hai aur equilibrium bohat baayen (left) taraf hai, is liye kam OH⁻ ions bante hain (12.2.1).

book_ref.quote: the equilibrium position being towards the far left side

blocks.prompt:
21 The basicity constant (Kb) of ammonia given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein ammonia ka basicity constant (Kb) kitna diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia ka Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ hai (12.2.1). 2.7 × 10⁻⁴ H₂SO₄ ki self-ionization ka constant hai.

book_ref.quote: due to the low basicity constant (Kb)

blocks.prompt:
22 The ammonia molecule has a pyramidal shape because of:
(Ammonia molecule ki shakal pyramidal kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ke lone pair ki wajah se ammonia ki shakal pyramidal hai (12.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia molecule has pyramidal shape due to lone pair of nitrogen

blocks.prompt:
23 When NH₃ changes into NH₄⁺, its shape changes from:
(Jab NH₃ NH₄⁺ mein badalti hai to us ki shakal kis se kis mein badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen apna lone pair chauthe H⁺ se bond ke liye istemal karti hai; phir ion tetrahedral shakal leta hai (12.2.2).

book_ref.quote: utilizes this lone pair of electrons to form ammonium

blocks.prompt:
24 In the ammonium ion, the four N–H bonds are:
(Ammonium ion mein chaar N–H bonds kaise hote hain?)

options.text: sab lambai aur taqat mein barabar

blocks.explanation: NH₄⁺ mein sab bonds lambai aur taqat mein barabar hote hain (12.2.2).

book_ref.quote: all the bonds are of equal length and strength

blocks.text: 12.2.3 Synthesis of ammonia from ammonium salts

blocks.prompt:
25 In the laboratory, ammonia gas is prepared by heating ammonium chloride with:
(Laboratory mein ammonia gas ammonium chloride ko kis ke saath garam karke banai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₄Cl jaise ammonium salt ko Ca(OH)₂ jaise base ke saath garam karke ammonia banti hai (12.2.3).

book_ref.quote: heating an ammonium salt such as ammonium chloride (NH₄Cl) with a base like calcium hydroxide

blocks.prompt:
26 The salt formed when ammonium chloride is heated with calcium hydroxide is:
(Ammonium chloride ko calcium hydroxide ke saath garam karne se kaun sa salt banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reactants mein sodium nahi, is liye calcium chloride banta hai: 2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃ (12.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is 2NH₄Cl(s) + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O(l) + 2NH₃(g).

blocks.prompt:
27 In the reaction of NH₄Cl with Ca(OH)₂, the ammonium ion acts as:
(NH₄Cl aur Ca(OH)₂ ke reaction mein ammonium ion kya kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh acid-base reaction hai: NH₄⁺ H⁺ deta hai (acid) aur OH⁻ H⁺ leta hai (base) (12.2.3).

book_ref.quote: NH₄⁺ acts as an acid by donating H⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
28 Using 2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃, the mass of NH₃ obtained from 10.7 g of NH₄Cl (NH₄Cl = 53.49 g mol⁻¹, NH₃ = 17.03 g mol⁻¹) is about:
(2NH₄Cl + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O + 2NH₃ se 10.7 g NH₄Cl (53.49 g mol⁻¹) se NH₃ (17.03 g mol⁻¹) ka mass taqreeban kitna hoga?)

book_ref.quote: This reaction displaces ammonia gas from the ammonium salt and produces salt and water

blocks.prompt:
29 In salt analysis, the presence of ammonium in a compound is shown when, on heating with a base, a gas is released that:
(Salt analysis mein ammonium ki maujoodgi tab sabit hoti hai jab base ke saath garam karne par aisi gas nikle jo:)

options.text: be-boo ho aur neela litmus laal kare
teekhi boo rakhti ho aur geela laal litmus neela kare

blocks.explanation: Teekhi boo wali gas jo geela laal litmus neela kar de (ammonia), compound mein ammonium ki nishani hai (12.2.3).

book_ref.quote: turns moistened red litmus paper blue

blocks.prompt:
30 While preparing ammonia by heating a solid mixture, the test tube is clamped sloping slightly downwards towards its mouth so that:
(Thos mixture garam karke ammonia banate waqt test tube ka munh thora neeche ki taraf kyun rakha jata hai?)

options.text: bana hua paani wapis garam sheeshe par na aaye aur use na tore

blocks.explanation: Taake bana hua paani wapis garam sheeshe par na behe aur use tor na de (12.2.3).

book_ref.quote: so that the water formed does not run back onto the hot glass and crack it

blocks.prompt:
31 The correct formula of ammonium nitrate is:
(Ammonium nitrate ka durust formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik NH₄⁺ aik NO₃⁻ ko balance karta hai, is liye ammonium nitrate NH₄NO₃ hai. NH₄NO₂ ammonium nitrite hai.

book_ref.quote: one NH₄⁺ ion balances one NO₃⁻ ion

blocks.prompt:
32 In the common oxides of nitrogen, the oxidation states of nitrogen range from:
(Nitrogen ke aam oxides mein nitrogen ki oxidation states kis se kis tak hain?)
blocks.explanation: NO, N₂O, NO₂, N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ mein oxidation states +1 se +5 tak hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: in which oxidation states range from I+ to V+

blocks.prompt:
33 The term NOₓ collectively stands for:
(NOₓ ki istilah (term) kin ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: NO aur NO₂ ko mila kar NOₓ kehte hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: NO and NO₂ are collectively called as NOₓ

blocks.prompt:
34 Which two oxides of nitrogen decay quickly to other oxides?
(Nitrogen ke kaun se do oxides jaldi doosre oxides mein toot jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ jaldi doosre oxides mein toot jaate hain (12.3).

book_ref.quote: N₂O₄ and N₂O₅ decay quickly to other oxides

blocks.prompt:
35 Laughing gas is:
(Laughing gas kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrous oxide, N₂O (oxidation state +1), ko laughing gas kehte hain (Table 12.2).

book_ref.quote: Nitrous oxide/ Nitrogen oxide (Laughing gas) N₂O

blocks.prompt:
36 Which oxide of nitrogen is used as a dental anaesthetic and a propellant for whipped ice cream?
(Nitrogen ka kaun sa oxide daanton ki anaesthetic aur whipped ice cream ke propellant ke taur par istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.2 ke mutabiq N₂O daanton ki anaesthetic, whipped ice cream ka propellant aur NaN₃ banane mein kaam aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Dental anaesthetic, propellant for whipped ice cream, synthesis of NaN₃

blocks.prompt:
37 Which statement about NO and its dimer N₂O₂ is correct?
(NO aur us ke dimer N₂O₂ ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: NO paramagnetic aur N₂O₂ diamagnetic hai

blocks.explanation: NO mein aik akela (unpaired) electron hai (paramagnetic); dimer N₂O₂ mein electrons jori bana lete hain (diamagnetic).

book_ref.quote: NO is paramagnetic while N₂O₂ is diamagnetic

blocks.prompt:
38 The total number of valence electrons in a molecule of NO is:
(NO ke aik molecule mein kul valence electrons kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: N ke 5 aur O ke 6 valence electrons: 5 + 6 = 11, is liye aik electron akela hai aur NO paramagnetic hai.

book_ref.quote: NO has 11 valence electrons

blocks.prompt:
39 Nitric oxide (NO) acts in the body as a biochemical messenger that:
(Nitric oxide (NO) jism mein biochemical messenger ke taur par kya karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.2: NO biochemical messenger hai jo blood pressure kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Biochemical messenger (Lowers blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
40 The colour of nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) is:
(Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) ka rang kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: NO₂ surkhi maail bhoori (reddish-brown) paramagnetic gas hai; N₂O₄ be-rang hai.

book_ref.quote: NO₂ is a reddish-brown gas, paramagnetic

blocks.prompt:
41 In the equilibrium 2NO₂ (brown) ⇌ N₂O₄ (colourless), cooling the mixture:
(Equilibrium 2NO₂ (bhoora) ⇌ N₂O₄ (be-rang) mein mixture ko thanda karne se kya hota hai?)

options.text: NO₂ zyada banta hai aur rang gehra hota hai
N₂O₄ toot kar N₂ aur O₂ banta hai
N₂O₄ zyada banta hai aur rang halka hota hai

blocks.explanation: Table 12.2: thanda karne se equilibrium aage, be-rang N₂O₄ ki taraf jata hai; garam karne se wapis bhoore NO₂ ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: 2NO₂ (Brown) ⇌ N₂O₄ (Colourless): Cool →, ← Heat

blocks.prompt:
42 Nitrogen dioxide reacts with water to form:
(Nitrogen dioxide paani se react karke kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.2: NO₂ paani se react karke HNO₃ aur HNO₂ banati hai.

book_ref.quote: reacts with water to form HNO₃ and HNO₂

blocks.prompt:
43 NO₂/N₂O₄ is used in:
(NO₂/N₂O₄ kis kaam aati hai?)

options.text: rocket propellant aur Ostwald process se HNO₃ banana

blocks.explanation: Table 12.2: NO₂/N₂O₄ rocket propellant, Ostwald process se HNO₃ banane aur explosives mein kaam aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Rocket propellant, HNO₃ formation by Ostwald process, explosives

blocks.prompt:
44 The oxidation state of nitrogen in N₂O₄ is:
(N₂O₄ mein nitrogen ki oxidation state kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2x + 4(−2) = 0, to x = +4 (NO₂ jaisi hi, Table 12.2).

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen dioxide/Nitrogen peroxide, Nitrogen tetraoxide NO₂, N₂O₄

blocks.prompt:
45 The IUPAC-recommended alternative names for ammonia and ammonium are:
(IUPAC ke mutabiq ammonia aur ammonium ke doosre naam kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: IUPAC ammonia ko azane aur ammonium ko azanium kehta hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: Another recommended name for ammonia by the International Union

blocks.prompt:
46 Azote, the Greek name of nitrogen from which azane is derived, means:
(Azote, nitrogen ka Greek naam jis se azane bana, ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Azote nitrogen ka Greek naam hai jis ka matlab 'no life' (zindagi nahi) hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: a Greek name for nitrogen, meaning

blocks.prompt:
47 Which of the following is a natural source of oxides of nitrogen?
(In mein se kaun sa nitrogen oxides ka qudrati (natural) zariya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qudrati zariye: bijli (lightning), volcanoes, biological decay, jangal ki aag, mitti ke microorganisms aur samandar (12.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Natural sources include lightning, volcanoes, biological decay

blocks.prompt:
48 During lightning, the oxide of nitrogen formed directly from air is:
(Bijli chamakne ke dauran hawa se seedha nitrogen ka kaun sa oxide banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bijli ke dauran hawa ki N₂ aur O₂ react karke NO banati hain: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO (12.4.1).

book_ref.quote: NO is produced when N₂ and O₂ in the air react during lightning

blocks.prompt:
49 The main man-made (anthropogenic) source of NOₓ is:
(NOₓ ka sab se bara insani (anthropogenic) zariya kya hai?)

options.text: gaariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels jalana

blocks.explanation: NOₓ ke bare insani zariye gaariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna hain (12.4.2).

book_ref.quote: The main anthropogenic sources of NOₓ are the combustion of fossil fuels

blocks.prompt:
50 Which of these is a man-made source of NOₓ rather than a natural one?
(In mein se kaun sa NOₓ ka qudrati ki bajaye insani zariya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical plants, biomass jalana aur welding insani zariye hain; samandar, decay aur bijli qudrati (12.4).

book_ref.quote: Other sources include chemical plants, biomass burning, welding

blocks.prompt:
51 Photochemical smog is also known as:
(Photochemical smog ko aur kis naam se jana jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photochemical smog ko Los Angeles smog kehte hain; classical smog London smog hai (12.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) forms in the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
52 Photochemical smog forms in the atmosphere from:
(Photochemical smog fiza mein kin cheezon se banti hai?)

options.text: dhoop mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds
raat mein CO₂ aur paani ke bukharat

blocks.explanation: Yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs) se banti hai (12.5.1).

book_ref.quote: from NOₓ and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the sunlight

blocks.prompt:
53 Which of the following is NOT one of the photochemical oxidants named in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein bataye gaye photochemical oxidants mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Photochemical oxidants maslan NO₂, ozone aur PANs hain; N₂ kam reactive hai (12.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Photochemical oxidants, such as NO₂, ozone, and peroxyacyl nitrates

blocks.prompt:
54 In photochemical smog, sunlight (hν) breaks NO₂ into:
(Photochemical smog mein dhoop (hν) NO₂ ko kis mein torti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dhoop mein NO₂ → NO + O; phir oxygen atom O₂ se mil kar ozone banata hai, O + O₂ → O₃ (12.5.1).

book_ref.quote: The formation of photochemical smog involves the following chemical reactions

blocks.prompt:
55 Photochemical smog is becoming more common than classical smog because of:
(Photochemical smog classical smog se zyada aam kyun ho rahi hai?)

options.text: paudon ki nitrogen fixation ka barhna

blocks.explanation: Barhte hue NOₓ ke ikhraj (emissions) ki wajah se photochemical smog classical (London) smog se zyada aam ho rahi hai.

book_ref.quote: classical smog (London smog) due to increasing NOₓ emissions

blocks.prompt:
56 According to the chapter, Lahore smog contains:
(Chapter ke mutabiq Lahore smog mein kya shamil hai?)

options.text: VOCs, NOₓ, zameeni satah ki O₃, PM2.5, CO aur SO₂

blocks.explanation: Lahore smog mein VOCs, NOₓ, zameeni satah ki ozone, PM2.5, CO aur SO₂ hain (12.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Lahore smog consists of volatile organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
57 In peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN), the R group is:
(Peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) mein R group kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R group CH₃ hai; doosri hydrocarbon chains se doosre PANs bante hain (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: The R group in peroxyacetyl nitrate is CH₃

blocks.prompt:
58 The abbreviation PBN stands for:
(PBN ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: NOₓ ke reactions se ozone, aldehydes, PANs aur peroxybenzoyl nitrate (PBN) bante hain (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) and peroxybenzoyl nitrate (PBN)

blocks.prompt:
59 In the formation of PAN, the aldehyde reacts with a hydroxyl radical to give:
(PAN banne mein aldehyde hydroxyl radical se react karke kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehyde hydroxyl radical se react karke acyl radical banata hai (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: The aldehyde then reacts with hydroxyl radical to produce acyl radical

blocks.prompt:
60 The acyl radical is converted into a peroxyacyl radical by reaction with:
(Acyl radical kis se react karke peroxyacyl radical banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acyl radical oxygen se react karke peroxyacyl radical banata hai (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: The acyl radical reacts with oxygen to produce peroxyacyl radical

blocks.prompt:
61 The last step in PAN formation is the reaction of the peroxyacyl radical with:
(PAN banne ka aakhri qadam peroxyacyl radical ka kis se reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peroxyacyl radical aakhir mein nitrogen peroxide (NO₂) se mil kar peroxyacyl nitrate banata hai (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: which finally reacts with nitrogen peroxide to form peroxyacyl nitrate

blocks.prompt:
62 The group at the end of a PAN molecule, RC(O)–X, is:
(PAN molecule RC(O)–X ke aakhir mein group X kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PAN RC(O)OONO₂ hai; Figure 12.5 mein chhapa OONO₃ ghalat hai (12.5.2).

book_ref.quote: OONO3 for OONO2 in the PAN formula

blocks.prompt:
63 A catalytic converter is built as:
(Catalytic converter kis tarah bana hota hai?)

options.text: charcoal se bhari sheeshe ki tube
ceramic ya metallic monolith, honeycomb jaisi banawat

blocks.explanation: Yeh ceramic ya metallic monolith hai jis ki shakal shehad ke chhatte (honeycomb) jaisi hai (12.6).

book_ref.quote: a ceramic or metallic monolith with a honeycomb-like structure

blocks.prompt:
64 The inner channels of a catalytic converter are coated with alumina to:
(Catalytic converter ki andar ki naaliyon par alumina ki teh kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alumina ki teh zyada surface area deti hai jis par noble metals phailai jaati hain (12.6).

book_ref.quote: Its inner channels have a layer of alumina to provide a high surface area

blocks.prompt:
65 The noble metals dispersed on the alumina of a catalytic converter are:
(Catalytic converter ki alumina par kaun si noble metals phailai jaati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alumina par Pt (platinum), Pd (palladium) aur Rh (rhodium) phailai jaati hain (12.6).

book_ref.quote: Noble expensive metals such as Pt (Platinum), Pd (Palladium), and Rh (Rhodium)
